include_count.description: Include user count for each group. Default is true.

handle.description: New @mention handle (without @). Changing this changes how users mention the group.

name.description: New display name for the group.

usergroup_id.description: ID of the user group to update (starts with 'S', e.g., 'S0123456789'). Get IDs from usergroups_list.

tools.name: usergroups_update

tools.description: Replace all members of a user group with a new list. WARNING: This completely replaces the member list - any user not in the 'users' parameter will be removed. users.description: Comma-separated user IDs that will become the COMPLETE member list (e.g., 'U0123456789,U9876543210'). All current members not in this list will be removed.
